name: Can panel molding help protect walls from damage?

mainEntity.name: Can panel molding help protect walls from damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, panel molding can offer a degree of wall protection, especially in high-traffic areas. When installed at a certain height, it can act as a buffer against scuffs, scratches, and minor impacts from furniture or daily activities, similar to wainscoting. This added layer of trim helps shield the lower portions of your walls, potentially reducing the need for frequent touch-ups and preserving the integrity of your paint or wallpaper over time. It's a subtle yet effective way to add durability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Panel molding can help protect walls in high-traffic areas by acting as a buffer against scuffs and minor impacts, similar to wainscoting.
